strategies.name: EMA Cross
strategies.summary: Goes long when a fast moving average rises above a slow one, and short when it falls below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when EMA(9) is above EMA(21). Short when EMA(9) is below EMA(21).
strategies.exit_rules: The position flips when the averages cross back.
strategies.weaknesses: Whipsaws in sideways markets. Lags after sharp moves.

strategies.name: RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: Buys after RSI shows a stock has fallen too far too fast, and sells once it recovers to the middle. Shorts the opposite when RSI is stretched high.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when RSI(14) closes below 30. Short when RSI(14) closes above 70.
strategies.exit_rules: Close a long when RSI rises above 50. Close a short when RSI falls below 50.
strategies.weaknesses: Strong trends keep RSI pinned high or low, so it can enter early and keep losing. Slow to exit after a sharp reversal.
